intro: Thirty-six clubs were drawn into one table on 27 August 2026: twenty-nine qualified directly, seven came through the qualifying rounds.

countries.note: The seven play-off winners, listed together because they came in by the same route.

gapNote: The rest of the field is not listed yet. Three searches agreed on the English and Spanish clubs and on the seven play-off winners, and Real Madrid and Inter are confirmed by the matchday one report. They disagreed on Italy — one named Como among the qualifiers and another said Como did not make the league phase — and gave the German, French, Portuguese and Dutch clubs only once. Naming a club that is not in the competition is the kind of mistake that gets a page quoted for years, so those stay out until they are checked twice.
checked: Checked against three separate searches on 11 September 2026. Only clubs confirmed twice, or by our own match report, are listed.
